metadata.scenario: A client urgently needs roadside assistance after being stranded with a flat tire. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Frank Miller. I need urgent help. I'm stranded with a flat tire. Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that! Where are you currently located? I'm on the side of Ridge Road, just a few blocks from home. Alright, we'll get someone out to help you as soon as possible. I really appreciate it. I have a doctor's appointment in an hour! Let me check our resources. Are you comfortable with a caregiver picking you up? Yes, but I need to get the tire fixed first. Understood. I can arrange for our transportation service to assist with that. That would be great, thank you! Let me confirm our transportation availability. One moment, please. (pause) Okay, we can send someone out to help you shortly. They can manage the tire issue as well. Perfect! How soon can they get here? Our driver should arrive within 20 minutes. I’ll make sure they prioritize your situation. Thank you so much! It’s really stressful out here. I completely understand, Frank. Just hang tight, help is on the way. Should I do anything while I wait? Just stay safe and let us know if anything changes. Will do. By the way, I need to schedule my next diabetic management visit. Yes, we can set that up once the urgent matter is resolved. Sounds good. I’d like my usual nurse, please. Of course! That will be the same nurse as your last visit, correct? Yes, that's right. Great! I’ll prepare that for you. Let’s confirm a date after you get to your appointment. Thank you, Margaret. You’ve been a huge help! It’s my pleasure, Frank. Just remember to call us back if you need anything else. I will. I’ll keep my phone on. Perfect! Drive safely, and we’ll talk soon. Thanks again! Bye. Bye!
